sc: The sign of the porter II is a Pocket-slot item, created with level 28 Divination using 35 bright energy and 1 sapphire necklace, yielding 5.
It does not always work on these items, such as grimy herbs dropped by monsters, despite working on the same herbs harvested from a patch.

Aetherium (Masterwork) Boots.x: Aetherium (Masterwork) Boots is a feet slot cosmetic override. It is unlocked by purchasing the Aetherium (Masterwork) Outfit.

Aetherium Boots.x: Aetherium Boots is a feet slot cosmetic override. It is unlocked by purchasing the Aetherium Outfit.

sc: It is made by custom-fitting augmented masterwork ranged body at the Master Crafter in the clothesmaking section of the Crafting Guild, or by augmenting custom-fit masterwork ranged body with an augmentor and 36 divine charges at an invention workbench.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.
A bagged hollyhock can be bought in the Garden of Kharid north of Al Kharid from Polletix for 20 coins.
Beachball Orb is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by activating a beachball orb token.
Beekeeper Outfit is a recolourable cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 2,000 spring tokens at the The Grand Eggs-change shop.
Björn is a companion pet that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
The pet could originally be unlocked by redeeming a green or red pre-paid game card between 1 and 31 October 2018.
A black naval shirt is a cosmetic item that can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 100 pieces of eight.
A blightleaf robe top is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
It can be found in a crate in the puzzle room, and should be repaired on the anvil to create a climbing hook head.
It is automatically removed when stopping the activity in any usual way, so players can't normally obtain the item in their backpack.
Cheer Hunter is a cosmetic override outfit available from the Christmas Spirit Shop for 5,000 Christmas Spirit.
Originally, it could rarely be obtained from opening a Twitch loot crate.
The chompy bird enhancer is a reward enhancer that doubles the kill count of chompy birds.

It can be received by trading Wythien ten crystal motherlode shards (requires completion of Plague's End), from Meg's questions if the Adventurer in Training perk is taken at May's Quest Caravan, or from a medium farming request at the Manor Farm.
They were also a reward from the event.
The citharede hood is an equipable reward from the One Piercing Note quest.
During the quest, it can be obtained from the robe cabinet and is used to make a dummy to trap the killer.
The Clover Axe is an override unlocked by redeeming a clover axe token.

Competitive Group Ironman platelegs 4.x: Competitive Group Ironman platelegs 4 is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Competitive Group Ironman armour 4.

sc: The conscript fragment is an item obtained during the Birthright of the Dwarves quest.
The corruption sigil is an item obtained from the Barrows Brothers.
It is possible to obtain multiple sigils per chest.
A cosmic tiara can be made by combining a cosmic talisman with a tiara.
Cosy Slippers (Penguin) is a feet slot cosmetic override that is unlocked by being on Santa's nice list during the 2024 Christmas event on any week starting from 22 December.
Cres Framework is a relic which is created by using the Transfer personality option on a golem framework after picking up a large memory in a Guthixian Cache.
Despite not being a standard Guthixian Cache, the Cres Framework may still be created with a large memory whilst inside the special instance of a Guthixian Cache entered during Twilight of the Gods.
Croesus' head is a boss trophy obtained from defeating Croesus.
The blueprints for the master farmer outfit must first be purchased from Granny Potterington at the Farmers' Market for 1,000 beans.
They can be traded, but only for other master farmer outfit pieces.

Crown of Loyalty IX.x: The Crown of Loyalty IX is awarded for having a continuous membership for nine whole years. The first 9-year crowns were awarded on 28 May 2020, 9 years after the introduction of the Members Loyalty Programme.

sc: Cyan Offhand Candy Cane is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Cyan Candy Cane Token.
The Dark Mage outfit is an outfit that can be purchased for 6 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 20 of Yak to Basics event with the premier pass and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for 2,000 oddments.
It can be created by using a soul dye on the Dark Shard of Leng.
Darting shadow is a drop from monsters in The Shadow Reef.
It can only be obtained while holding a Lucky charm (Shadow Reef).
The decaying journal can be obtained by killing the skeletal horror.
After reading it, it can be found in the bookcase of a player-owned house if lost.
It is made by attaching a divine sigil, a very rare drop from the Corporeal Beast, to a blessed spirit shield.
refers to things which come from a supernatural power or deity, such as a god, being sacred or holy.
The gauntlets can be obtained as a reward from either Triskelion Treasures (unlocked using the Crystal triskelion) or as a very rare reward from the crystal chest.
While Triskelion Treasures and crystal chest are for members only, the gauntlets can be traded to and worn by F2P (free-to-play) players as well.

Elven Ranger Gloves.x: Elven Ranger Gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that are part of the Elven Ranger set.

sc: If the key is destroyed before completing all the treasures, another key can be obtained from Jorral in the Outpost in the north-west of West Ardougne and the south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
The key's precursor is first obtained during the Making History quest.
In The Light Within, the player learns that the enchanted key is actually called the Amserdrwys and is an elven artefact created by the Trahaearn Clan long ago.
The dust can be made by crushing an alchemical hydrix, giving 10 dust per gem.

Eternal magic headless shaft.x: Eternal magic headless shafts are items created by combining eternal magic shafts and feathers which can in turn be combined with primal arrowheads to create primal arrows.

sc: The fish flingers medal enhancer is a reward enhancer that doubles the number of medals obtained in Fish Flingers.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 20 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
Forinthry Royal Off-Hand Dagger is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 46 of Forinthry Frontier with the premier pass.

It must be telegrabbed in the lab to be obtained.

Highland war paint (purple, male).x: Purple highland warpaint is part of the highland outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

It can be made by anyone with the required Crafting level and at least level 50 for all skills.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 152 spirit shards, a blue charm, and a mithril bar in the backpack, requiring 66 Summoning and giving 580.

Mysterious book.x: The mysterious book is documentation for clues received in the Cryptic Clue Fest II. It is given to the player by Roddeck at the first day of the fest.

Nocturnal Guard.x: The Nocturnal Guard is a main hand necromancy weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Nocturnal Weapon Bundle.

sc: The pendant of Invention is a pendant of skill that may be obtained by converting a Prismatic pendant that was won from the Squeal of Fortune.

Pharaoh's shendyt (red, male).x: The red pharaoh's shendyt is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Quick-Fire Off-hand Crossbow.x: The Quick-Fire Off-hand Crossbow is a cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store. It costs 144 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 130 RuneCoins for members.

sc: A ring of small parcel is an item that can be obtained by exchanging 150 postage stamps.
They were previously rarely obtained when opening small parcels.

Samba top (green).x: The green samba top is part of the samba outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The scrimshaw of magic is an item that can be made within a player-owned port workshop once all four scroll pieces of the scrimshaw have been obtained.
Silk can be bought from various silk traders around RuneScape.
Silk cannot be made by a player in the game.
Silun the Bird of Paradise is a companion pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 10 of Journey to Iaia.
It could be purchased for 1,250 Contribution Points from the Gielinor Games Reward Shop during the Gielinor Games if the silver tier of rewards was unlocked.
A small dungeoneering lamp is a reward from the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
After completing the medium Morytania achievements, 13 small zombie monkey bonemeal and 13 bucket of slime can be obtained daily by giving small zombie monkey bones to Robin in Port Phasmatys.

Snowverload Snowstormer is an aura slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1,000 Christmas spirit from the Christmas Spirit Shop; not to be confused with Portable Snowfall, which is also an aura slot cosmetic override that can be purchased from the shop.
Snowverload Snowstormer could originally be obtained during the 2014 Christmas event upon reaching 375 Christmas cheer.
Special flour is an item obtained by operating the windmill levers on the north of Skillchipx.
Spinebeam shortbow (unstrung) is an item that can only be obtained and used while in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a knife (in the inventory or tool belt) on Spinebeam branches.

Symbol of Devastation is a neck slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through the Academy of Mages promotion from Treasure Hunter, or by redeeming a Symbol of Devastation token.
It is made by dyeing a tectonic robe top with Shadow dye.

Tribal skirt (red).x: The red tribal skirt is part of the tribal outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Umbral Diplomacy is a journal obtained in The Shadow Reef by picking up a waterlogged scrap in the dungeon.

It can be purchased from the Smuggled Goods shop for 3 warped tokens.
